Localmouth aggregates local information for places in the UK. It provides events, property, jobs, news and other listings relevant to a given village, town or suburb.

See all the text links to images in one window without scrolling or clicking. Heres an example, you are on reddit and there is a thread about movie posters. Multiple people have posted multiple images in the thread. TikiPik scrapes the page, finds all those links and give you a preview of them in a pop up. From there you can click any link and see it 100% in a new tab.

The Stream Assessment Project provides information on the general health of streams. The project was partially funded by a grant from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and was completed in October 2009.

TapTravel is a mobile application that allows users to search for and book for flights. TapTravel is available in all major mobile platforms. The Allmyles API has been integrated into this application.
As you type a location, Google Maps Instant centers a map on the best result that is returned from Google's geocoder. The tool is surprisingly good at determining cities based on partial input.
HouseinCity is a search portal for residential apartments .It offers features like metro connectivity and proximity search.

The Feline Finder app uses RescueGroups.org http/json API to show loacally adoptable cats. By answering a few simple questions you can find the cat that's perfect for you. You can also view a ranked list of cat breeds based on how you answered the questions, learn about different cat breeds via descriptions and YouTube videos.

Millions homes for sale on Google map and Birds Eye View. Neighborhood information, crime rates, schools profiles and more.
It allows users to have a little more fun with their lists by having them read back via browser or phone. Share lists and collaborate with others.
Get your personalized RSS feed containing only news of bands you like (those in your Last.fm library).

A Web-based reader for FriendFeed that displays your feed in the left frame. Web sites referenced in the feed are displayed on the right. See what your friends are linking to. AJAX interface auto-refreshes your feed. Implemented on Google App Engine.

If you ever had problems ordering camera supplies from a vendor in NYC, then this map might be of interest. It plots the locations, along with photos and comments, of dozens of vendors. Not always reputable ones.
